title: Extending countrycode for small-island research
text: Researchers working Small Island Developing States (SIDS), Caribbean, sub-sovereign territories run two recurring frictions joining classifications onto data. first sub-sovereign disambiguation. Aruba (AW), Curaçao (CW), Sint Maarten (SX) ISO 3166-1 codes, Bonaire, Sint Eustatius, Saba share BQ. country-code packages either drop three collapse one row, silently corrupts joins. second classification. UN-DESA’s SIDS list, including sovereign associate members, broader sub-national island jurisdiction (SNIJ) literature, standard fields country-code dictionaries. Researchers tend keep side spreadsheet hand-copy onto project. islandcodes one thing: ships classification list, disambiguating codes sub-sovereign cases, helpers work alongside countrycode.

title: Extending countrycode for small-island research
text: Notice Aruba returns TRUE is_sids is_snij. UN-DESA SIDS associate member sub-national island jurisdiction within Kingdom Netherlands. Bonaire returns FALSE SIDS TRUE SNIJ: part Netherlands proper special municipality, separate jurisdiction recognised UN-DESA. package accepts country names, ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes, hyphenated extensions used three BES islands.
code: library(islandcodes) #>  #> Attaching package: 'islandcodes' #> The following object is masked from 'package:datasets': #>  #>     islands  is_sids(c("Aruba", "Curacao", "Bonaire", "Brazil")) #> [1]  TRUE  TRUE FALSE FALSE is_snij(c("Aruba", "Curacao", "Bonaire", "Brazil")) #> [1]  TRUE  TRUE  TRUE FALSE is_sids(c("AW", "CW", "BQ-BO", "AX", "BR")) #> [1]  TRUE  TRUE FALSE FALSE FALSE

title: Extending countrycode for small-island research
text: territory carries two kinds location, WGS84 decimal degrees: representative point main landmass (latitude, longitude) capital city (capital, capital_latitude, capital_longitude). island_coords() returns vector names codes, input order. two semantics differ dispersed territories. French Polynesia landmass point sits near Tahiti capital Papeete; United States landmass point continental interior, far Washington.

title: Extending countrycode for small-island research
text: island_distance() turns coordinates great-circle (haversine) distances. Given single set returns symmetric matrix, exposes spread Dutch Caribbean, ABC islands Venezuela SSS islands 900 km northeast. Pass second argument distances one origins set destinations. shorter side recycled, single origin many destinations gives distance . = "capital" measures capital cities instead landmass points, unit switches kilometres, statute miles, nautical miles. helpers keep input order fill unresolved rows NA, slot directly pipeline: resolve column names, attach coordinates distances, rank isolation hand points mapping package. quick isolation measure island’s nearest neighbour, smallest -diagonal distance row.
code: round(island_distance(c("AW", "CW", "BQ-BO", "SX", "BQ-SA", "BQ-SE"))) #>        AW  CW BQ-BO  SX BQ-SA BQ-SE #> AW      0 122   191 962   920   933 #> CW    122   0    73 908   863   873 #> BQ-BO 191  73     0 856   811   818 #> SX    962 908   856   0    49    62 #> BQ-SA 920 863   811  49     0    32 #> BQ-SE 933 873   818  62    32     0 island_distance("Aruba", c("Curacao", "Bonaire", "Sint Maarten")) #>       CW    BQ-BO       SX  #> 121.5695 190.7913 961.7026 island_distance("AW", "CW", which = "capital", unit = "nmi") #>       CW  #> 71.96274 abc <- island_distance(c("AW", "CW", "BQ-BO")) diag(abc) <- NA apply(abc, 1, min, na.rm = TRUE)  # km to nearest of the other two #>        AW        CW     BQ-BO  #> 121.56948  73.01551  73.01551

title: Reference list of countries and territories with small-island classifications — islands
text: curated dataset 251 countries territories, including sub-sovereign island jurisdictions (Aruba, Curacao, Bonaire, Sint Maarten, French overseas collectivities, Aaland Islands, others) typically collapsed omitted ISO 3166-1 country-code lists.

title: Reference list of countries and territories with small-island classifications — islands
code: islands

title: Reference list of countries and territories with small-island classifications — islands
text: data frame 251 rows 18 columns: name Short common name (e.g. "Aruba", "Curacao", "Bonaire"). label Display label, used upstream XLSForm survey. iso_code ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code, hyphenated extensions     three BES islands (BQ-BO Bonaire, BQ-SE     Sint Eustatius, BQ-SA Saba) can distinguished     within shared BQ prefix. wb_region World Bank region. wb_income_group World Bank income group. political_association Sovereign power non-independent     territories; "Independent" otherwise. is_sids 1 UN-DESA recognised Small Island Developing     State (member associate); 0 otherwise. sids_tier "Sovereign member", "Associate member",     NA applicable. is_snij 1 sub-national island jurisdiction; 0 otherwise. criterion_small 1 meets small-population/small-area     criterion; 0 otherwise. criterion_island 1 island archipelago; 0 otherwise. criterion_developing 1 classified developing; 0 otherwise. criterion_sovereign 1 sovereign state; 0 otherwise. latitude Representative point main landmass, WGS84     decimal degrees. NA United States Minor Outlying Islands. longitude Representative point main landmass, WGS84     decimal degrees. capital Capital city name, NA uninhabited /     capital-less territories. capital_latitude Capital city, WGS84 decimal degrees. capital_longitude Capital city, WGS84 decimal degrees.

title: islandcodes 0.2.0
text: islands dataset gains five coordinate columns (WGS84 decimal degrees): latitude/longitude (representative point territory’s main landmass) capital/capital_latitude/capital_longitude (capital city). Sourced Natural Earth hand-curated supplement BES islands, French overseas departments, small territories; see upstream island-research-reference-data provenance. New island_coords() returns coordinates vector names ISO codes, = "point" (default) = "capital". New island_distance() gives great-circle (haversine) distances islands: full symmetric matrix among one set, element-wise/recycled distances two. Supports (point capital) unit (km, mi, nmi). Base R, new dependencies. Bug fix: Namibia longer dropped islands. ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 code literal string "NA", data-build step previously treated missing value. dataset now 251 rows (250).

title: islandcodes 0.1.0
text: Initial CRAN release. Bundled islands reference dataset: 250 countries territories classifications SIDS, SNIJ, World Bank region income group, political association, four small-island defining criteria. Predicates is_sids(), is_snij(), is_small_island() accept country names, ISO codes, hyphenated BES sub-codes (BQ-BO, BQ-SE, BQ-SA). island_lookup() add_island_cols() tidy joining onto research data. small_islands() shorthand filtered subsets. aruba() — .R.U.B.. (Annotated Reference -coded Border Areas): convenience wrapper around island_lookup() Aruba default. homage Edward Cheung’s .R.U.B.. (ASCS/NCS Relay Unit Breaker Assembly) Hubble Space Telescope. Source data mirrored github.com/University--Aruba/island-research-reference-data CC 4.0.
